notablePrerequisites:
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}.
You have no other Illusions on the battlefield or in your graveyard.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
The token Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}{U}.
The nontoken Palinchron enters the battlefield, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate the token Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the nontoken Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
